action: No action needed; for awareness. Organisations with EU exposure should add the listed names to sanctions screening and expect continued NoName057(16) DDoS activity.
exec: EU sanctions now cover a pro-Russian DDoS group and a disinformation firm, which affects sanctions screening and dealings with listed parties.
plain: The EU has put sanctions on a Russian propaganda firm, some of its staff and commentators, and the pro-Russian hacker group NoName057(16) that runs denial-of-service attacks.
summary: On 16 November the Council of the EU added the Moscow firm Social Design Agency, 24 of its staff and six pro-Kremlin commentators to its Russia destabilising-activities regime, and listed the pro-Russian hacktivist group NoName057(16) under its cyber sanctions regime. Cyble counts 30 people and two entities; The Record counts 31 names in the first group. Both report the Council says the group carried out denial-of-service attacks on critical infrastructure and election candidates.
title: EU sanctions Social Design Agency and NoName057(16) over Russian disinformation and cyberattacks

validation.note: Cyble and The Record, both read; they cite the Council decision and press release of 16 November (not read directly). Totals differ slightly between them (30 people plus 2 entities vs 31 names).

review.note: Cyble and The Record: 16 Nov, SDA + 24 staff + 6 commentators, NoName057(16) cyber listing match; summary now says the Council DoS statement is as reported by both outlets (Council text not read)
